common.tagline: Bith homeworld scarred by a long-ago bioweapon catastrophe.
hyperlanes: Colundra Sector trunk off the Hydian Way
common.famousFor: Bith musicians and acoustic engineers. Refined dome cities. The lingering scars of a bioweapon disaster.
common.cantinaReputation: Homeworld of the Bith. Once a center of art, music, and science, Clak'dor VII was devastated by a chemical war centuries ago. The surviving Bith live in sealed cities and are renowned across the galaxy as musicians and engineers. In 15 BBY, the planet's orbital stations offer competent technical services and cantinas with the best live music in the sector.
